{{Quote|I used to be respected, you know. My word carried weight. One tiny mistake, and suddenly no one trusts me!|Jeelg, to an Imperial spacer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jeelg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Biography==
At some point prior to or during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jeelg was promoted to the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Sith military at which point several men serving under him planned him a surprise party to celebrate. Being an extremely paranoid individual, he believed they were instead secretly planning a mutiny and attacked the men, an act he later described as "one tiny mistake" that caused his superiors to dismiss his further worries. This led to his posting in [[Soh'va Work Camp]] outside [[Kaas City]] where he soon became paranoid that he was being spied upon by [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] spies. His fears were confirmed when he hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to collect a [[Holocomm/Legends|holocommunicator]] from one of the Kubaz as proof they were present, which the spacer successfully did.
